name: Bounded screenshot runtime-proof LFS pilot
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - cloud/runtime-proof-lfs-pilot-20261023
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/runtime-proof-lfs-pilot.yml
permissions: {}
jobs:
  upload-and-verify:
    if: github.repository == 'qianyizhang/med-assets' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/cloud/runtime-proof-lfs-pilot-20261023'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      contents: write
    env:
      GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT: '0'
      APPROVED_MANIFEST: >-
        {"objects":[{"oid":"c00a5379d65443d3a848ff7940eb7ac5f910ee8bf463385a5a3cdb9322990424","size":62818,"url":"https://anatomy-verification.landy123007.chatgpt.site/review/runtime/software-ci-heart-lymph-2026-10-23/images/heart-exact-loop.canvas.png","type":"png","file":"images/heart-exact-loop.canvas.png"},{"oid":"1c1b528fb3f9828d33298840a3105cf959d95d2b1947b6540437c85d35ac897e","size":69455,"url":"https://anatomy-verification.landy123007.chatgpt.site/review/runtime/software-ci-heart-lymph-2026-10-23/images/heart-exact-loop.display-crop.png","type":"png","file":"images/heart-exact-loop.display-crop.png"},{"oid":"d83e64ff1114fef92940a4029e0998e18794dc99603a73b7b7aef073f2b39da2","size":61907,"url":"https://anatomy-verification.landy123007.chatgpt.site/review/runtime/software-ci-heart-lymph-2026-10-23/images/heart-full-1.canvas.png","type":"png","file":"images/heart-full-1.canvas.png"},{"oid":"c74eaf59988d287bee8424980609078f03b5f72cc3381c92c8a508621846ea4f","size":68595,"url":"https://anatomy-verification.landy123007.chatgpt.site/review/runtime/software-ci-heart-lymph-2026-10-23/images/heart-full-1.display-crop.png","type":"png","file":"images/heart-full-1.display-crop.png"},{"oid":"71ba2b9a8adb3feb6c60549513d0914e9d1337ef21b9526568c69d333622fd34","size":61403,"url":"https://anatomy-verification.landy123007.chatgpt.site/review/runtime/software-ci-heart-lymph-2026-10-23/images/heart-full-2.canvas.png","type":"png","file":"images/heart-full-2.canvas.png"},{"oid":"d60c0145c5f50022a6dd0902955b2313b6dd157ff70a4ac2e9e853f9536297d2","size":68159,"url":"https://anatomy-verification.landy123007.chatgpt.site/review/runtime/software-ci-heart-lymph-2026-10-23/images/heart-full-2.display-crop.png","type":"png","file":"images/heart-full-2.display-crop.png"},{"oid":"942d5fe18c8ee6b2f9e09d2474a85f0e10b956743231d0ab4f8cd0a8b66bdb76","size":29890,"url":"https://anatomy-verification.landy123007.chatgpt.site/review/runtime/software-ci-heart-lymph-2026-10-23/images/heart-valves-0.canvas.png","type":"png","file":"images/heart-valves-0.canvas.png"},{"oid":"19ee60a863ff27f9e3ee669d0a81c16e74225c557da5c7fb84dab9c67dcd5a22","size":24919,"url":"https://anatomy-verification.landy123007.chatgpt.site/review/runtime/software-ci-heart-lymph-2026-10-23/images/heart-valves-0.display-crop.png","type":"png","file":"images/heart-valves-0.display-crop.png"},{"oid":"e8ec4a49dfdc4161dbbe4e21d1b22937ec083fd4e12327a7ea1350e423983f41","size":28529,"url":"https://anatomy-verification.landy123007.chatgpt.site/review/runtime/software-ci-heart-lymph-2026-10-23/images/heart-valves-1.canvas.png","type":"png","file":"images/heart-valves-1.canvas.png"},{"oid":"e763591b1925d83a68630b739b450b61fd409a4a231e5f65787fec5781adf80c","size":23406,"url":"https://anatomy-verification.landy123007.chatgpt.site/review/runtime/software-ci-heart-lymph-2026-10-23/images/heart-valves-1.display-crop.png","type":"png","file":"images/heart-valves-1.display-crop.png"},{"oid":"7595e639f072088a227d048cc840b1575fda1139b7850fc1be92df14fb5e8a20","size":30028,"url":"https://anatomy-verification.landy123007.chatgpt.site/review/runtime/software-ci-heart-lymph-2026-10-23/images/heart-valves-2.canvas.png","type":"png","file":"images/heart-valves-2.canvas.png"},{"oid":"ddfdd40721767c372ebf29f0e03783ed17dc6cc78cf67a502f009fefc733ec09","size":25031,"url":"https://anatomy-verification.landy123007.chatgpt.site/review/runtime/software-ci-heart-lymph-2026-10-23/images/heart-valves-2.display-crop.png","type":"png","file":"images/heart-valves-2.display-crop.png"},{"oid":"c14fd9a94cec7120ad2f3b7af7a12fbfbef74513e8cd161f6edbb4ec0d949093","size":51726,"url":"https://anatomy-verification.landy123007.chatgpt.site/review/runtime/software-ci-heart-lymph-2026-10-23/images/lymph-capsule-hidden.canvas.png","type":"png","file":"images/lymph-capsule-hidden.canvas.png"},{"oid":"f5356a466141cbc0334814f98f9754e0db982e1dfda2f6fecd84a3f9bfed0c2d","size":52123,"url":"https://anatomy-verification.landy123007.chatgpt.site/review/runtime/software-ci-heart-lymph-2026-10-23/images/lymph-capsule-hidden.display-crop.png","type":"png","file":"images/lymph-capsule-hidden.display-crop.png"},{"oid":"c96c800f1a92403aebe0d6c8071d12978286c78cc7deefbc131b961a1655bec3","size":37327,"url":"https://anatomy-verification.landy123007.chatgpt.site/review/runtime/software-ci-heart-lymph-2026-10-23/images/lymph-full.canvas.png","type":"png","file":"images/lymph-full.canvas.png"},{"oid":"e2de1bc1b38a6cd9621b94b03d4d101914ab16e59f77beeb2092fd65a33b7b79","size":35175,"url":"https://anatomy-verification.landy123007.chatgpt.site/review/runtime/software-ci-heart-lymph-2026-10-23/images/lymph-full.display-crop.png","type":"png","file":"images/lymph-full.display-crop.png"}]}
    steps:
      - name: Configure temporary repository authentication
        uses: actions/checkout@d23441a48e516b6c34aea4fa41551a30e30af803
        with:
          fetch-depth: 1
          lfs: false
          submodules: false
          sparse-checkout: .gitattributes
          sparse-checkout-cone-mode: false
          persist-credentials: true
          show-progress: false
      - name: Verify sources, upload missing among 16 exact PNG OIDs, and independently read back
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import gzip, hashlib, io, json, os, pathlib, re, subprocess, urllib.parse, urllib.request
          
          manifest = json.loads(os.environ["APPROVED_MANIFEST"])
          objects = manifest["objects"]
          assert len(objects) == 16 and len({o["oid"] for o in objects}) == 16, "Unexpected object count"
          assert sum(o["size"] for o in objects) == 730491, "Unexpected total bytes"
          assert sum(o["size"] for o in objects) <= 5000000, "Approved batch cap exceeded"
          assert max(o["size"] for o in objects) <= 69455, "Per-object limit exceeded"
          assert all(re.fullmatch("[0-9a-f]{64}", o["oid"]) and 0 < o["size"] <= 69455 for o in objects), "Invalid object constraints"
          work = pathlib.Path(os.environ["RUNNER_TEMP"], "runtime-proof-approved-pilot")
          work.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
          
          # Every source is public. Do not read or pass GitHub credentials to source URLs.
          for o in objects:
              parsed = urllib.parse.urlsplit(o["url"])
              assert parsed.scheme == "https" and parsed.hostname in {"cdn.humanatlas.io", "anatomy-verification.landy123007.chatgpt.site"}, "Unapproved source host"
              assert parsed.username is None and parsed.password is None, "Credentials in URL refused"
              encoding = o.get("encoding", "identity")
              assert encoding in {"identity", "gzip"}, "Unapproved source encoding"
              transfer_size = o.get("transportSize", o["size"])
              transfer_oid = o.get("transportOid", o["oid"])
              assert 0 < transfer_size <= 69455 and re.fullmatch("[0-9a-f]{64}", transfer_oid), "Invalid transport constraints"
              if encoding == "gzip":
                  assert "transportSize" in o and "transportOid" in o, "Gzip transport manifest required"
              else:
                  assert transfer_size == o["size"] and transfer_oid == o["oid"], "Identity transport mismatch"
              req = urllib.request.Request(o["url"], headers={"User-Agent": "med-assets-runtime-proof-pilot/1.0", "Accept-Encoding": "identity"})
              with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=45) as response:
                  assert urllib.parse.urlsplit(response.url).scheme == "https", "Non-HTTPS redirect refused"
                  transport = response.read(transfer_size + 1)
              assert len(transport) == transfer_size and hashlib.sha256(transport).hexdigest() == transfer_oid, "Transport size or SHA-256 mismatch"
              if encoding == "gzip":
                  with gzip.GzipFile(fileobj=io.BytesIO(transport)) as compressed:
                      data = compressed.read(o["size"] + 1)
              else:
                  data = transport
              assert len(data) == o["size"], "Source size mismatch"
              assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() == o["oid"], "Source SHA-256 mismatch"
              if o["type"] == "png":
                  assert data[:8] == bytes([137,80,78,71,13,10,26,10]), "Source is not PNG"
              elif o["type"] == "glb":
                  assert data[:4] == b"glTF", "Source is not GLB"
              elif o["type"] == "webp":
                  assert data[:4] == b"RIFF" and data[8:12] == b"WEBP", "Source is not WebP"
              else:
                  raise AssertionError("Unapproved content type")
              (work / o["oid"]).write_bytes(data)
              print(f"SOURCE VERIFIED {o['oid']} {o['size']} bytes", flush=True)
          
          subprocess.run(["git", "lfs", "version"], check=True)
          subprocess.run(["git", "lfs", "install", "--local"], check=True)
          # Validate every LFS pointer before uploading any object.
          for o in objects:
              with (work / o["oid"]).open("rb") as source:
                  clean = subprocess.run(["git", "lfs", "clean", "approved-" + o["oid"]], stdin=source, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, check=True)
              expected = f"version https://git-lfs.github.com/spec/v1\noid sha256:{o['oid']}\nsize {o['size']}\n".encode()
              assert clean.stdout == expected, "Generated LFS pointer mismatch"
          # Query destination again and upload only genuinely missing approved objects.
          preflight_endpoint = "https://github.com/qianyizhang/med-assets.git/info/lfs/objects/batch"
          preflight_payload = json.dumps({"operation":"download","transfers":["basic"],"objects":[{"oid":o["oid"],"size":o["size"]} for o in objects]}).encode()
          preflight_headers = {"Accept":"application/vnd.git-lfs+json","Content-Type":"application/vnd.git-lfs+json"}
          with urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(preflight_endpoint,data=preflight_payload,headers=preflight_headers),timeout=45) as response:
              preflight_result = json.load(response)
          preflight_objects = {o["oid"]:o for o in preflight_result.get("objects",[])}
          assert set(preflight_objects) == {o["oid"] for o in objects}, "Unexpected preflight objects"
          missing = set()
          for o in objects:
              remote = preflight_objects[o["oid"]]
              assert remote.get("size") == o["size"]
              error = remote.get("error")
              if error:
                  assert error.get("code") == 404, "Destination returned an error other than missing object; stop"
                  missing.add(o["oid"])
              else:
                  assert remote.get("actions",{}).get("download"), "Destination unavailable"
          for o in objects:
              if o["oid"] not in missing:
                  print(f"ALREADY PRESENT SKIPPED {o['oid']} {o['size']} bytes",flush=True)
                  continue
              subprocess.run(["git", "lfs", "push", "--object-id", "origin", o["oid"]], check=True)
              print(f"UPLOAD COMMAND PASSED {o['oid']} {o['size']} bytes", flush=True)
          
          # Independent HTTP readback, without the local LFS cache or GitHub user credentials.
          endpoint = "https://github.com/qianyizhang/med-assets.git/info/lfs/objects/batch"
          payload = json.dumps({"operation": "download", "transfers": ["basic"], "objects": [{"oid": o["oid"], "size": o["size"]} for o in objects]}).encode()
          headers = {"Accept": "application/vnd.git-lfs+json", "Content-Type": "application/vnd.git-lfs+json", "User-Agent": "med-assets-runtime-proof-pilot-readback/1.0"}
          with urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(endpoint, data=payload, headers=headers), timeout=45) as response:
              result = json.load(response)
          returned = {o["oid"]: o for o in result.get("objects", [])}
          assert set(returned) == {o["oid"] for o in objects}, "Unexpected LFS Batch objects"
          for expected in objects:
              obj = returned[expected["oid"]]
              assert obj.get("size") == expected["size"] and "error" not in obj, "GitHub object unavailable"
              action = obj.get("actions", {}).get("download")
              assert action and urllib.parse.urlsplit(action["href"]).scheme == "https", "Invalid LFS download action"
              req = urllib.request.Request(action["href"], headers=action.get("header", {}))
              with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=45) as response:
                  assert urllib.parse.urlsplit(response.url).scheme == "https", "Non-HTTPS LFS redirect refused"
                  data = response.read(expected["size"] + 1)
              assert len(data) == expected["size"] and hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() == expected["oid"], "GitHub LFS readback mismatch"
              print(f"GITHUB READBACK VERIFIED {expected['oid']} {len(data)} bytes", flush=True)
          print("PASS: 16 exact objects; 730491 bytes; no Git asset pointer or branch-tip commit pushed by this job.", flush=True)
          PY
